DESCRIPTION:THIS AGREEMENT WILL PROVIDE ASSISTANCE TO MARQUETTE UNIVERSITY IN ITS EFFORTS TO ASSESS THE POTENTIAL OF THERMAL NETWORKS FOR THREE DEVELOPMENT SITES NEAR DOWNTOWN MILWAUKEE. ACTIVITIES:MARQUETTE UNIVERSITY WILL ASSESS THE CURRENT USES OF THERMAL ENERGY AND FUTURE THERMAL NEEDS NEAR THESE SITES, EVALUATE THE APPROPRIATENESS OF AMBIENT TEMPERATURE SOURCES AS GEOTHERMAL HEAT EXCHANGES, AND ASSESS THE THREE SITES FOR INSTALLATION OF NEW GEOTHERMAL WELLS. THROUGH THESE ACTIVITIES, MARQUETTE UNIVERSITY WILL PRODUCE A REPORT EVALUATING THE THREE SITES FOR NETWORKED GEOTHERMAL SUITABILITY AND DISSEMINATE THE REPORT TO LOCAL STAKEHOLDERS.SUBRECIPIENT:NO SUBAWARDS ARE INCLUDED IN THIS ASSISTANCE AGREEMENT.OUTCOMES: EXPECTED OUTCOMES INCLUDE REDUCED GREENHOUSE GAS EMISSIONS AND IMPROVED AIR QUALITY. INTENDED BENEFICIARIES INCLUDE RESIDENTS OF THE CITY OF MILWAUKEE.

THE PURPOSE OF THIS ORDER IS TO PROCURE THE SERVICES OF ERG TO PERFORM THE DUTIES AS OUTLINED IN THE CONFLICT PREVENTION AND RESOLUTION CENTER JUST IN TIME DISPUTE RESOLUTION PROJECTS SOW. THIS ORDER ALSO INCORPORATES THE APPROVED WORK PLAN AND COST
